title: Autobuilder FailureCapsule
description: Structured crash record emitted by Stage 3 when an iteration fails to produce metrics.json or any hard gate errors out. Translated from jeryu/src/capsule.rs:14 (GitLab-CI-specific fields generalized).

stage.description: Which gate raised: cargo-check, cargo-clippy, cargo-test, cargo-deny, miri, audit, proof-lanes, metric-harness.

log_snippet.description: Last ~50 lines of stderr/stdout. Secrets-redacted (no TOKEN, KEY, SECRET, PASSWORD substrings).

repro_script.description: Self-contained shell snippet that re-runs the failing stage from a clean checkout of commit_sha.

environment.description: Non-sensitive environment variables. Keys containing TOKEN/KEY/SECRET/PASSWORD are excluded.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary, e.g. 'clippy_warning failure in stage cargo-clippy on branch autobuilder/rev-cli'.

superseded_by_sha.description: If a later iteration fixed this failure mode, the commit SHA that resolved it.

retry_count.description: How many fix attempts have been made on this failure (≤3 before the loop gives up).
